## LankaServe v3.0.2

This release adds the Master Supervisor Agent, which connects the four AI agents for citizens and officers. It also makes duplicate detection stricter, syncs application status between officers and the mobile app in real time, and adds a CI workflow that runs every test suite.

### Highlights

- **Master Supervisor Agent** - one orchestrator that coordinates Agents 1 to 4, with stricter guards against made-up answers. It runs two workflows: the citizen pre-application pipeline and officer verification.
- **Citizen Assistant chat (mobile)** - a supervisor chat with rich formatting and access to the Agent 2 eligibility auditor.
- **Officer Copilot (web)** - recommendations now match the audit findings and are written in plain language. Markdown tables display correctly.
- **Auto-fill and pre-submission check (mobile)** - Agent 3 fills in the application form and Agent 4 checks it before it is submitted.

### AI agents

- Supervisor intent classification improved, with the supervisor tools registered in the backend and the application context provider updated.
- Fixed how the service ID is resolved and how state is kept in the supervisor workflows.
- Agent results get new styling on mobile and web, and statutory audit results on mobile have a clearer, institutional layout.

### Backend

- **Stricter duplicate detection** - a citizen can't submit a second application for a service while one is active or already approved. NIC matching ignores case and extra spaces.
- Duplicate checks no longer depend on a PostgreSQL-only query (`ILike`), so they also run against the in-memory test database.
- Multi-stage verification only shows each stage's own documents in the officer workspace.
- When an officer takes action, the application status updates instantly in the mobile app.

### Web portal

- Newly registered departments appear when creating or editing officers, and each gets its own dashboard link.
- The officer draft panel shows the improved duplicate validation results.

### Mobile app

- Citizens see their verified collection pass, and each application can only book one collection appointment.
- Completion booking for multi-stage applications.
- Citizen NIC shown on verification task cards.
- Fewer duplicate agent buttons, and clearer entry points to the AI guide and eligibility audit.
- iOS build fix.

### Testing and CI

- New `Testing` workflow (`.github/workflows/testing.yml`). It runs every suite in `test/` on each push and pull request: `AgenticAi.Tests`, `Backend.Tests` and the web Vitest tests.
- Updated the tests to match the new duplicate rules and department handling.
- Fixed failing CI/CD pipelines.

### Known issues

- `POST /api/orchestrator/chat` and `POST /api/orchestrator/workflows/citizen-pipeline` need no login.
- The officer orchestrator endpoints accept the roles `Verification Officer` and `SuperAdmin`, which no account has. Only Department Admins can use them for now.

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/Goverment-Service/Government_Service_Navigator/compare/v3.0.1...v3.0.2
